title: The Candle Cellar
intro: The cellar door slams shut behind you. A single black candle flickers on a table. Somewhere in this room is the key to the first vault.

candle: Think about what fraction of each candle is left after some hours.
The thick candle loses 1/6 of its length every hour, the thin one 1/4. Write what remains of each after t hours.
Look closely at the wax pooled at the foot of the candle: remaining thick = 2 x remaining thin is the equation to solve.
Solve 1 - t/6 = 2 x (1 - t/4). The answer is a whole number of hours. The vault's first character is the letter K.
painting: Place the Baron first: the facts leave only two possible frames for him.
Facts 2 and 3 settle the Baron. Then use the Maid, who sits between the Doctor and the Butler.
The Widow hangs at the far right end of the row. The Doctor, Maid and Butler fill frames 2, 3 and 4.
The row from the left is: Baron, Doctor, Maid, Butler, Widow. The vault's second and third characters are the digit 7 and the letter R.
vent: Do not look at the numbers themselves. Look at the gaps between them.
The gaps are 1, 2, 4 and so on. What would the next gap be?
Add the next gap to the last number on the row. The scratched numbers are behind the portraits.
The next gap is 16, so the dial needs 34. The vault's last character is the digit 4.
vault: The code has four characters: a letter, a digit, a letter and a digit.
Each object you solved gave you part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: candle, portraits, vent.
